claims.claim: The SHAAM allocation-number (heshbonit Israel) regime began in May 2024 and the number is 9 digits. Thresholds, VAT-exclusive, on the invoice issue date: NIS 25,000 from May 2024, NIS 20,000 from January 2025, NIS 10,000 from January 2026, NIS 5,000 from June 2026. Invoices dated before May 2024 never required one. A number is required only where all four conditions hold: above the threshold in force on that date; the invoice carries a VAT component; the recipient is an osek murshe; and the recipient asked for one. A missing number blocks the RECIPIENT's input-VAT deduction and does not void the invoice.
claims.verification_note: Thresholds confirmed on the official gov.il allocation-number service page (20,000 for 2025, 10,000 from 1.1.2026, 5,000 from 1.6.2026). That page returns HTTP 403 to scripted fetches, so it cannot be substring-checked automatically.
